research_notes: Follow-up: identify early retail employer and dates, verify DPC facilitation appointment, ministerial office boundaries, DJCS executive/acting terms, hours and leave. Resolve 2021–2022 work and Bouverie clinical/study overlap; establish VACCA historical governance and university treatment.

2026-09-29 review: APH, first speech, La Trobe employer/alumni source, VACCA organisational sources, official traditional-owner review and IPAA senior-role list. Broader adviser/department queries resolved department and titles but not individual appointment dates/FTE.

DPC Right People for Country appeared only in a contact-aggregator result and is retained as a lead, not adopted as verified payroll identity. Ministerial staff cannot be merged into departmental public service merely because dates are adjacent.
No day boundaries, FTE or zero totals invented. EPOF 2019–2021 is a collective forum period, not proof of her whole tenure. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; unresolved initial record.

2026-10-02 follow-up: employer annual report resolves DPC identity previously supported only by aggregator, corroborates ministerial sequence and DJCS senior roles. Public profile supplies Right People for Country title. University source dates certificate2010/master2013; study/employment overlap retained. First-person2019 account adds lecturing, potentially same Bouverie work, and employment since18 without proving uninterrupted service. Targeted programme/annual-report/hour searches did not establish exact acting period, FTE, retail employer or2021–22 work. Next: DPC appointment/leave and programme reports, DJCS acting instruments, Bouverie payroll/study dates and historical governance. No years calculated.

2026-10-03 follow-up materially narrows DJCS role progression: IPAA Victoria's2020 award list identifies Stewart as Executive Director, Aboriginal Justice; the DJCS structure explicitly current30June2021 and a parliamentary inquiry's July2021 reproduction identify her as Acting Deputy Secretary. These are dated role snapshots, not appointment instruments, continuous-service or FTE evidence. Searches did not locate an exact promotion or departure day, hours, leave,2021–22 bridge work, early retail employer, DPC appointment instrument or Bouverie payroll/study terms. December2021 reporting concerns prospective Pascoe Vale candidacy and is not converted into employment. No duration calculated.

2026-10-04 follow-up: targeted 2021–2022 bridge and Department of Justice searches returned the current APH biography and first speech, both ending public-service occupation in 2021, plus 2022 Senate-election/candidacy reporting. Candidacy is not converted into paid employment, and no employer, contract, hours, leave or exact DJCS departure date surfaced. The first speech reiterates retail work and employment from age18 but still does not identify the retailer or dates. Generic web search is exhausted for this pass; DJCS/DPC appointment instruments, Bouverie payroll records and early retail evidence remain decisive. No substantive fact changed.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted Bouverie staffing/annual-report, retail identity and individual full-/part-time searches yielded no new admissible hours, contract or early employer. VACCA-hosted first speech corroborates existing sequence without narrowing boundaries. Sydney plant retailer Microcosm, US culinary faculty and Michigan graduate-student near-full-time work belong to namesakes; they were excluded. Ranger jobs she announces and another university colleague’s maternity leave are not her employment terms. No substantive addition. DJCS/DPC personnel instruments, historical Bouverie staffing records and self-disclosed retail history remain decisive; do not repeat generic hours searches absent a new lead.
